text:
sara: Heads up — we saw a weird cost/scale tail overnight in apac. Promo traffic + a bunch of long-embedding jobs triggered repeated burst provisioning; autoscaler kept adding nodes and then sat up for ~2h. Cost spike ~+28% for the window.

infra-bot: [autoscale-snapshot] region=apac, window=02:00-04:00 UTC, added_gpus=38, avg_p99_latency_ms=2400, sustained_util=46%, burst_peak_util=92%, scale_up_events=27, scale_down_events=3

mike: yikes. any idea which tenant(s) caused it?

sara: Looks like promo-tagged tenants and a single customer running large-batch embedding jobs. Correlated with customer-tag=promo_2026_apac.

jesse: My quick read: autoscaler allowed transient reservations to accumulate because decay interval is long (default 120m) and we treat promo-tag as high-priority so it bypassed some cost caps. Proposal: introduce a transient_reservation decay and a cost_signal throttle that drops burst allowance when projected hourly spend > budget_threshold.

jesse: example autoscaler config snippet (proposal):
```json
{"region":"apac","transient_reservation":{"enabled":true,"decay_minutes":30,"max_concurrent_burst":6},"cost_signal":{"enabled":true,"budget_threshold_pct":110,"throttle_factor":0.4}}
```

luca: also suggest mixing in more preemptible instances during burst window (auto-preemptible_ratio: 0.6) so we reduce steady-state cost if a burst persists. We should be careful w/ P99 for latency-sensitive routes though.

anita: cost wins sound good, but will this change push P99 > SLA? we need canary + dashboarding before rolling wide.

jesse: agreed — plan: canary on a low-traffic eu1 region for 24h, collect these queries:
```promql
rate(gpu_serve_latencies_ms_bucket{route=~"/chat|/embed"}[5m])
quantile_over_time(0.99, gpu_request_latency_ms[1h])
```
Set alert if p99 increases > 10% vs baseline or error rate increases > 0.1%.

mike: who's owning the quick patch and ticket?

sara: I will open an infra-ticket with the config diff and rollout plan. Patch + canary target: eu1, then rollout to apac after 24h if green.

infra-bot: ticket INFRA-3281 created by sara: "transient reservation decay + cost_signal throttle — canary in eu1"

luca: command to apply a temporary override for the canary: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://infra-api.redwood.internal/v1/autoscaler/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"eu1","override":{"transient_reservation":{"decay_minutes":30,"max_concurrent_burst":6},"preemptible_ratio":0.6}}'
```

anita: please add the cost dashboard panels to the ticket (hourly spend, added_gpus, preemptible_pct). I'll review SLA impact.

mike: sounds like a good plan. one ask: add a short-lived emergency rollback flag we can flip (override:force_rollforward=false) in case autoscale oscillates.

jesse: will add rollback hook and a runbook snippet in the ticket.

sara: action items in INFRA-3281: create canary override (sara), add dashboards (anita), add rollback hook + alerts (jesse), monitor for 24h then decide (all).

mike: :thumbsup:

anita: :eyes: assigning to me for dashboards

luca: will stand by to flip rollback if needed

infra-bot: canary override applied to eu1 at 2009877200 (user=sara)

sara: thanks everyone — will post results in 24h and update ticket.
